basis.title: Design standards: employer's requirements – Technical Manual (ER-DFE-XX-XX-T-X-0201, revision A-C01)
basis.label: External windows and doors (including glazed/louvred components): 25 years
basis.note: Printed page 97. External windows and doors, material not stated. Minimum life expectancy (design requirement) for DfE-funded school buildings. Minimum design requirements placed on contractors for school buildings, not observed replacement ages. Section 5.1.4 (sanitaryware) refers to CIBSE Guide M Appendix 12.A1 'in general'.

basis.title: Future Buildings Standard: final stage impact assessment (RPC-MHCLG-25104-IA), 24 March 2026
basis.by: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government (UK)
basis.label: "external windows which was assigned an asset life of thirty years"
basis.note: Printed page 77. External windows, frame material not stated. Assumption for new non-domestic buildings in England; the IA says the lifetimes are in line with BS EN 15459 (Annex/Appendix E), but they are stated as the department's own modelling assumptions, not a reproduced table. Round-number economic-appraisal assumptions, not observed lives. Same values as the January 2021 Future Buildings Standard consultation IA (separate file), so the two are not independent.
